title: I know nothing about wine
description: The fundamental foundations for understanding wine

lessons.title: Types of wine
lessons.intro: Wine is mainly divided into three categories: red, white and rosé. The color depends on the type of grape and the way it is processed. There is no better wine: it depends on taste.
lessons.final: Now you know how to distinguish the main types of wine.

questions.question: What are the three main types of wine?

feedback.correct: Exactly! Red, white and rosé are the main categories.
feedback.wrong: No, those are taste descriptors, not types of wine.

questions.question: The color of the wine depends only on the grape.

feedback.wrong: No, the workmanship is also fundamental.

questions.question: Rosé is:
answers: An intermediate wine between red and white

feedback.correct: That's right, it is obtained from red grapes with short contact with the skins.
feedback.wrong: It is not a mix of wines.

questions.question: There is a wine that is better than the others.

feedback.correct: Right, it depends on personal taste.
feedback.wrong: There is no absolute best wine.

lessons.title: How wine is made
lessons.intro: Wine comes from a process called fermentation. The sugars in the grapes are transformed into alcohol thanks to yeasts.
lessons.final: Now you know how wine is made.
